basic_details.job_title: GIPE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Research Assistant, Research Associate Posts

application_fee.details: The application fee is payable online.

age_limit.details: The age limit for the advertised posts is preferably below 40 years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | research assistant: Master’s degree in Economics/ Statistics,/ Data Science /Social Sciences/ Population Studies or a related discipline. Experience: Ability to identify, access and extract data from diverse sources; familiarity with Census of India, NSO/NSS, Maharashtra Government publications, District Statistical Abstracts and Tribal Development Department data; proficiency in MS Excel, STATA, R or Python for data organisation and cleaning. | research associate: PhD. / Master’s degree in Economics, Statistics, Social Sciences, Data Science, Population Studies or a related discipline. Experience: Strong working knowledge of Marathi and English; ability to independently identify, extract, clean, validate and analyse large and diverse datasets; proven research-writing, documentation and report-preparation skills.

salary_details.details: The positions are temporary for a period of 4 months under the Compendium of Tribal Statistics Project (Tribal Research & Training Institute, Maharashtra State, Pune).

how_to_apply: Visit the official website of Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics at gipe.ac.in.
Locate the advertisement notification for the Compendium of Tribal Statistics Project dated October 07, 2026.
Review the detailed eligibility criteria and job description for the Research Assistant or Research Associate post.
Complete the online application form with the required personal and academic details.
Upload necessary documents, datasets familiarity proofs, or certificates as required by the application portal.
Pay the online application fee of Rs. 236/- through the designated digital payment gateway.
Submit the application form before the application end date of October 14, 2026, and print a copy for future records.

content_sections.heading: GIPE Research Assistant Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The project notification includes a total of 2 temporary vacancies across two positions for the Compendium of Tribal Statistics Project.

rows.qualification_required: Master’s degree in Economics/ Statistics,/ Data Science /Social Sciences/ Population Studies or a related discipline. Experience: Ability to identify, access and extract data from diverse sources; familiarity with Census of India, NSO/NSS, Maharashtra Government publications, District Statistical Abstracts and Tribal Development Department data; proficiency in MS Excel, STATA, R or Python for data organisation and cleaning.

PhD. / Master’s degree in Economics, Statistics, Social Sciences, Data Science, Population Studies or a related discipline. Experience: Strong working knowledge of Marathi and English; ability to independently identify, extract, clean, validate and analyse large and diverse datasets; proven research-writing, documentation and report-preparation skills.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment project name for GIPE Research Assistant 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Compendium of Tribal Statistics Project under the Tribal Research & Training Institute, Maharashtra State, Pune.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under GIPE Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy notified for the Research Assistant post, and a total of 2 vacancies including the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GIPE Research Assistant 2026?
faq.answer: The application end date is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree in Economics/ Statistics/ Data Science / Social Sciences/ Population Studies or a related discipline along with data extraction and handling experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GIPE Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GIPE Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The online application fee is Rs. 236/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly remuneration for the GIPE Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 30,000/- per month for a period of 4 months.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or temporary recruitment position?
faq.answer: The position is temporary for a duration of 4 months.
